notes: FEVER DAY 4 — fever down, runny nose nearly resolved, cough persists. Urine back to pale yellow (rehydration confirmed). Weight 72.7 kg (-0.2), body water up to 55.0% (+0.4) and 40.0 kg mass — hydration fully restored. Fat mass 14.5 kg. Scale HR still 106 bpm ('Over') — elevated, infection not fully cleared. Took 1 ORS sachet. Face feels bloated — likely sodium load (ramen + samosa + ORS) plus illness-related fluid retention.
